title: padus virginiana f. leucocarpa
intro: Padus virginiana f. leucocarpa, commonly known as Chokeberry, is a deciduous shrub or small tree in the rose family, known for its edible fruit. The health benefits of Chokeberry include its high antioxidant content, which has been linked to reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Chokeberry include its use as a natural remedy for digestive issues, fever reduction, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Chokeberry include anthocyanins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
